description: The plot illustrates the loss of various models over the number of iterations. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 140000, and has tick labels at intervals of 20000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss", has a linear scale, and ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The plot displays six lines representing different models: Vanilla (purple, solid line), StrmLLM (n=64) (blue, solid line), SepLLM (n=64) (orange, solid line), SepLLM (n=64, H) (green, solid line), SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (red, solid line), and SepLLM (n=128) (dark blue, solid line). All lines start at a loss around 3.35 at 0 iterations and decrease rapidly to a minimum loss between 2.7 and 2.9 around 40000 iterations, before gradually increasing to a stable loss between 2.7 and 2.9 at 140000 iterations. The Vanilla model has a loss of approximately 2.7 at 40000 iterations and 2.72 at 140000 iterations. The StrmLLM (n=64) model has a loss of around 2.85 at 40000 iterations and 2.88 at 140000 iterations. The SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), and SepLLM (n=64, H/T) models have losses between 2.7 and 2.8 at 40000 iterations and between 2.75 and 2.8 at 140000 iterations. The SepLLM (n=128) model has a loss of approximately 2.75 at 40000 iterations and 2.78 at 140000 iterations.
